result.stdout:
Usage: resourceTranslator [options]

Options:
  -f, -filename (required)
  -endpoint, -texttranslationendpoint (required)
  -key, -apikey (required)
  -of, -fileoutputformat (required)
  -outdir, -outputdir
  -target, -targetcultures
  -source, -sourceculture
  -region (required)
  -format, -outputformat
      Specify format to save result as. Leave empty to use input format. possible options are (Xml, Json, Yaml) 
  -overwritevalues, -overwriteexistingvalueswithnewtranslations
  -sort, -autosort
  -skip, -skipexistingoutputs
  -encoding
  --optionsfile
      Path to a JSON file containing the options. CLI flags override its values.

  -h, --help
      Show this help and exit.
